note: RV park on the Sonoma County Fairgrounds in Santa Rosa, run by the fair's event center and open to overnight RVers outside fair time, with back-in and pull-through rows on a paved lot. Self-contained rigs only; the park is not residential. Fair and event weeks bring crowds and paid visitor parking. --Claude
summary: Fair RV page, rules PDF and Sept 2026 site map read. $70-95 a night (30/50 A, pull-throughs), Good Sam 10%, 60-day window, 28-night max, no tents. Ordinary nightly guests shown year-round. Google 3.8/383 (local, rule not applied). Not waterfront kept.
flags: FAIRGROUND TEST: passes - regular nightly rates and a Firefly booking engine; the rules call it 'NOT a residential park' with a 28-night cap, and visitor-parking charges apply 'during Fairground events', so the park stays open around events.

GOOGLE: 3.8 (383 reviews). Ownership is local (fair and event center, the operator's email is a sonomacounty.gov address), so the private-park under-4.0 automatic drop does not apply; reported for the reviewer.
PRICE: $70 lowest RV night (Good Sam $63) - over $50, but the gate is private-only; local, so no drop.
LONG-STAY: a long-term option for workers exists ('For long term pricing and application'), but nightly stays are the norm and the maximum stay is 28 days; not a long-stay park.
RIG AGE: 'rigs older than 15 years are not allowed' - a 2023 rig passes.
HOOKUPS: water and sewer at sites are not stated by the operator; left unknown.
SITE COUNT: stored 160 (note prose) unverified; the Sept 2026 map shows roughly that many numbered A/B sites but could not be counted reliably from the text layer. Left unchanged.
FIREFLY: the booking engine was not opened; per-site availability and lengths unread.
PHONE: '' -> 707-293-8410 (rules PDF and Google listing); the office line on the page is (707) 545-4200 ext. 212.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront agrees (paved lot amid fairground barns; nearest water a golf-course pond ~450 m).
